cues: Microbes come in four groups, and the group decides the treatment.
Bacteria are prokaryotes with a peptidoglycan wall and small ribosomes, the only group antibiotics can touch.
Viruses are not even cells: just nucleic acid in a coat, multiplying inside our cells.
Then protozoa and fungi, both eukaryotes.
Bacteria are named by shape and by the Gram stain.
